about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for hse-hsg247 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The Box 8.1 text block drops the Pre-use, Daily and Weekly checks group headings, so the weekly check runs on into the last daily bullet and reads as a daily check.
findings.evidence: source: "testing of RCDs. Weekly checks Visual check of electrical equipment for damage" / tree: "testing of RCDs. Visual check of electrical equipment for damage, wear, overheating etc."

findings.problem: Box 8.1 is given twice, once as running text and again as a table placed after paragraphs 8.43-8.47.
findings.evidence: tree: "Box 8.1 Supervisors' checklist for asbestos hygiene units Visual check" and table rows "Pre-use checks", "Daily checks", "Weekly checks"

findings.problem: The Box 8.1 table comes after the Showering and laundering text, but the box is printed above it on the page.
findings.evidence: table "Maintenance and cleaning of hygiene facilities" listed after "8.47 Laundry operators"

findings.problem: The subheading 'Laundering of coveralls and towels' is kept as a note, and the small headings Coveralls, Towels and Laundry operators are run into the body text.
findings.evidence: source: "Laundering of coveralls and towels" (heading) / tree: note "Laundering of coveralls and towels"; "Coveralls 8.43 Coveralls used"
